result.title: Multi-Token Prediction and Alternative Tokenization Improve Learning Latent Multi-Hop Graph Search at Scale
result.comment: Don't be intimidated by the page length :)
result.summary: Given an unseen graph, a start node, $s$, and an end node, $t$, can a language model generate the shortest path from $s$ to $t$? Prior work has found that models fail to learn this task as the graphs scale. We show that this failure has two causes: the supervision signal and the tokenization. First, we theoretically establish and empirically demonstrate the effectiveness of multi-token prediction (MTP), and show that the benefits of MTP are topologically agnostic. Second, we introduce alternative tokenizations and show that the two causes are orthogonal. Using these methods, we break through the scaling wall observed by prior work, consistently and stably learning to solve the task at scales far beyond previous limits.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究语言模型在图上生成最短路径的多跳搜索任务，指出监督信号与 tokenization 是规模化失败的两个正交原因，并用 multi-token prediction（MTP）和替代 tokenization 突破此前的规模限制。
AI.relevance_reason: 虽非视觉工作，但其 MTP 监督可能缓解多跳轨迹的信用分配，tokenization 分析可供核查长程搜索中状态表示与监督粒度如何影响 LVR；迁移到 VLM 推理仍需验证。
